name: Hour of the Wolf
source:
Doralice is a senior living the last few months of high school she'll ever have.  Everything simultaneously feels too stifling and ready to burst. It's the perfect time to throw a massive party. But everyone's too caught up in their own desires, and there's something strange out there in the woods...

[From [url=https://devsonder.itch.io/hour-of-the-wolf]Itch.io[/url]]
translation:
多拉丽丝是一名高年级学生，她即将度过高中的最后几个月。一切都同时让人感觉太窒息，随时可能爆发。这是举办大型派对的最佳时机。但每个人都太沉迷于自己的欲望，而树林里却出现了一些奇怪的东西……

[来自[url=https://devsonder.itch.io/hour-of-the-wolf]Itch.io[/url]]
